data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 黄昏潮汐中的孤岛凝望
data.description: 夕阳将海面染成了灿烂的金橙色。白羽浸泡在浅滩的温水中，深色泳装勾勒出少女纤细的腰身。她回首望向岸边，眼底的防备终于被温存彻底取代。
data.location: shallow ocean surf of a secluded cove reflecting molten copper sunset rays
data.action: wading waist-deep in evening ocean waves, wet swimsuit hugging slender silhouette, looking back over shoulder with a serene gentle smile
data.lighting: intense fiery orange sunset backlighting water ripples and translucent white hair
data.mood: breathtaking poetic serenity, ethereal summer solitude, profound romantic acceptance
data.promptProse: Wading through glowing sunset sea waves, Shiroha turns back with damp white twintails and soft affectionate crimson eyes.
data.animaCaption: Shiroha standing in glowing sunset waves, looking back with a soft tender smile.
